name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — Intermediate — Illusion of Perfection

system.description: Invented by Dr. Mortius to hide his own deformities in public, this nearly hour-long ritual requires a plain white mask donned at the moment of completion. Once finished, the caster appears to be an ordinary, nondescript person in his mid-20s, letting him blend easily into a crowd or facilitate an escape. Mortius shares this ritual gladly with friendly Tremere. Kindred with Auspex can see through the disguise — and, to the discoverer's dismay, so can Lupines.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Dr. Mortius's own creation)
